nom: First Aid Beauty Brighten + Glow Exfoliating Gel Cleanser with AHA and Jojoba Pearls

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-acne-prone skin report the cleanser leaves their skin feeling clear and soft without excess oil, and several use it specifically for daily exfoliation of an oily t-zone.
segments.dry: The reviewers with dry skin say the exfoliation felt surprisingly gentle and did not leave their skin feeling tight or stripped.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including combination-acne-prone, describe it as effective without over-drying or irritating, though one notes it doesn't leave skin feeling deeply nourished on its own.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including several with rosacea, report no irritation or breakouts even with frequent use, though one reviewer's sensitive skin broke out in several places after her first use.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the cleanser does not leave their skin feeling tight, dry or stripped, though a few, including one with combination-acne-prone skin, note it doesn't leave skin feeling deeply moisturized on its own and needs a follow-up moisturizer; one reviewer specifically says it does dry her face.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers with rosacea report the cleanser did not trigger any flare-ups even with daily to twice-daily use, calling it surprisingly gentle for reactive skin.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report fewer visible blackheads or clearer skin with regular use, while one reviewer with sensitive skin broke out in several places after her first use.
concerns.spots: A few reviewers, including one with oily, acne-prone skin, report their skin tone evened out and some acne scars faded with continued use.
concerns.oiliness: A couple of reviewers with oily skin say the cleanser leaves their face feeling clean and soft without excess oil.
concerns.barrier: Multiple reviewers specifically note the cleanser brightens and exfoliates without stripping the skin's moisture barrier.

aspects.libelle: Gentle jojoba exfoliating pearls, not like harsh old-school scrubs
Beads can be difficult to rinse off fully
A little product goes a long way
Can sting if it gets into the eyes
Doesn't lather or foam as much as some expect

extraits.titre: Watch out for the exfoliating beads
extraits.texte: This cleanser has a great consistency and does a great job of cleansing my skin. The scent is pleasant without being overpowering and I really like the pump bottle because it's easy to use. Unfortunately, the exfoliating beads are a the drawback. They're very difficult to rinse off and I had to rinse my face at least four times just to remove most of them. I still noticed leftover beads throughout the day whenever I touched my face. Overall, I was disappointed with this cleanser. While I liked the formula, scent, and packaging, the beads made it frustrating to use. I will not be purchasing it again. [This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.]

I was happy with the size of the bottle I received. The instructions were clear and all ingredients listed on the bottle. My skin was very sensitive to the product. I broke out in several places on my face after using the first time. My skin is usually not sensitive. I think maybe the product is made for younger skin.

extraits.titre: Not A Holy Grail - But Close
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have to preface here- this cleanser is definitely one of the higher performing ones I have tried, which means a lot coming from someone who has combination, acne prone, sensitive skin. Despite having exfoliating beads in it, not once did I feel like my skin was being stripped, nor did I have irritation. My face felt sufficiently clean after I rinsed the cleanser off my face without feeling totally like a sahara desert. But if you are expecting nourished, baby soft, smooth and moisturized as if the cleanser had oils in it, you will not be getting that. That being said, you can still use this cleanser daily without running into problems. Nourished skin wasn't an issue for me as I still expect to put on either a moisturizer directly after this or continue with a rigorous skincare routine depending on how I continued to trial this (as I was doing separate tests since May to give this cleanser my full efforts in an honest attempt to review it fairly). In addition, no matter what I put on face afterwards, I had no complications. Thus, I would say that the cleanser overall is very safe to pair with most products. None of the ingredients made my skin freak out whatsoever, either. The formulation was very gentle on my skin and it lathers very well. A little goes an incredibly long way and the bottle I can see lasting an incredibly long time for the price point. The pump was nice and I had no problems with dispensing product.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I noticed immediate results after cleansing with the First Aid Beauty Brighten and Glow exfoliating Gel Cleanser being that my skin looks much brighter, healthier. It is VERY foamy for a gel cleanser, a little goes a very long way which I really love! I also love that is a dual exfoliation cleanser using lactic acid (my favorite) and jojoba beads for a physical exfoliation and it's fairly gentle on the skin. I use this once a week, sometimes twice a week as it's very effective and someone with sensitive skin I wouldn't reccomend it any more than that. My skin was immediately brighter and more even after one wash and now that have been using it about a month I've noticed brightness all around my face and my skin tone substantially more even. It has also really helped with the congestion I get on my chin and gas kept that maintained. I recommend this highly!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have oily, acne prone skin, so I'm always looking for products that help keep my skin feeling clear without leaving it dry or stripped. I've really been enjoying this cleanser because it leaves my skin feeling clean, smooth, and refreshed after every use. After using it for a few weeks, I noticed my complexion looked a little brighter and my skin felt softer. It has a lightweight gel texture, and it rinses away easily. I'd definitely recommend it if you're looking for a gentle exfoliating cleanser that cleanses well without feeling harsh or drying!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have been using this face wash for about a month now and I'm SHOCKED! I have rosacea and usually exfoliating face washes are not for me. However, I've been using this one 1-2 times daily and it's been amazing! It's gentle enough for every day use, hasn't irritated my rosacea whatsoever, and leaves my skin feeling amazing. It lathers well, fragrance free, and is non-drying. I will absolutely continue to purchase! If you're looking for a great gentle exfoliating face wash - this is IT!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've really been enjoying this cleanser! I have dry skin, so I'm always careful with exfoliating products, but this one feels surprisingly gentle. The gel texture is lightweight, and the jojoba pearls provide a mild physical exfoliation without feeling harsh. After rinsing, my skin feels clean, smooth, and refreshed without that tight, stripped feeling.
